prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ProjectFinal DECOR GAME expansion atlas. Reference 1 is the target cozy home aesthetic, reference 2 shows existing compatible furniture. Warm walnut wood, sage/olive green, ivory cream, softly shaded crisp pixel art with thin brown edges, orthographic elevated 3/4 top-down RPG viewpoint, NO isometric diagonal ground axes. 1536x1536 square canvas. EXACT 4 ROWS x 4 COLUMNS, 16 isolated full objects, equal regular cells, at least 25 px clear transparent gutters at all cell boundaries. Each ROW is ONE consistent identical item in four cardinal views. Columns: 1 DOWN front toward viewer, 2 RIGHT front facing screen-right, 3 LEFT front facing screen-left, 4 UP rear toward viewer. Correct physical rotation around vertical axis, NEVER rotate the image in the picture plane. Same size, materials and construction across views. Strong side-view silhouettes; back views show actual rear of objects. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard or background color, no gradient, no cast shadows beyond silhouette, no text/labels/grid lines. Complete silhouettes fully inside cells. Larger objects large enough for detail; small objects naturally smaller, not huge. The items within a combined furniture set remain attached consistently across ALL four views. ROW1 a walnut writing desk with one drawer pedestal, computer monitor displaying a green landscape, keyboard and mouse neatly sitting on desk, as ONE combined placeable furniture item. No chair, no trash bin included. ROW2 a separate dark charcoal padded swivel OFFICE CHAIR with five caster wheels. ROW3 one small dark grey rectangular open-top wastebasket. ROW4 a low walnut TV cabinet with a slim flat-screen TV mounted centrally on top and one small book in shelf, as ONE combined item; screen dark subtle reflection, no plant, no lamp. Rear view shows backs of monitor/TV and simple discreet cables.
